Reviewed 2026-11-02: the remaining finding is go-jose/v3 v3.0.5, which has no upstream patch. The exact Caddy build dependency chain is modules/standard -> modules/caddypki -> smallstep/certificates/authority -> go.step.sm/crypto/jose -> go-jose/v3. The committed Caddyfile exposes only reverse proxies for the three validated public domains, disables the admin API, and configures neither the internal PKI/ACME server nor untrusted JWK provisioning. Thus the vulnerable private-RSA JWK parser is outside the configured request path. The separately linked go-jose/v4 is patched and asserted at v4.1.6. This exception must be removed or re-reviewed before enabling internal PKI, ACME-server/provisioner/JWK features or expiry. Upstream: https://github.com/go-jose/go-jose/security/advisories/GHSA-mgcc-cww5-fp2q
